notes: source-fixed and target-mean-projection are references: they never pass through the QP, so their constraint verdicts are statements about the reference point, not about an optimiser success.
target-mean-projection enforces only the box, so it can (and does) violate the non-increase caps; that is exactly why the QP exists.

a solve that does not meet the tolerance is labelled status=not_converged/infeasible, the delivered point is the SOURCE point, and the row is marked fallback_to_source=True: 'migration not completed', never a success.
the stale_hops constraint is a training-internal linear proxy and is reported as a proxy, not a chemical or sensory measurement.
trans-2-nonenal (the measured column) carries the non-increase statement for the oxidation defect; the t2n sensory proxy is reported as a diagnostic and its increases are counted, not hidden.
the energy statistic here is V = 2*mean d(G,R) - sum d(G,G)/m^2 - sum d(R,R)/n^2 and U = 2*mean d(G,R) - mean d(G,G) - mean d(R,R) (signed, can be negative; never clipped or square-rooted).
the 231 stored chemical columns are used as-is; the 226+5 derived-feature identities are NOT verified here.

v6 fix (half-space intercept): the stale row is a'z <= b with b = a'z_source + STALE_TOL = f(z_source) - c + STALE_TOL. The old code used f(z_source) + STALE_TOL, i.e. it forgot to subtract c; all c are negative, so the old feasible box was strictly smaller than declared. Every certificate now records c, a'z_source, b, a'z-b and f(z_new)-f(z_source).

v6 fix (source data state): a missing or floor-coded source cell cannot prove that the REAL source concentration did not increase; such records are not_identifiable and are excluded from the verified denominator, while the numeric bound check is recorded separately as conditional_on_imputation / conditional_floor_code.

v6 addition: target-mean-projection-full projects the same target mean onto the full declared feasible set (box ∩ stale half-space) and is the fair baseline; the old box-only target-mean-projection is retained as a diagnostic and still violates the stale row, which is why it is not the comparison.

objective_gradient_check.explanation: the objective is a rank-10 quadratic plus lambda*L2 plus eta*L1; it is smooth except at the L1 kink |z_i-z_source,i|=0. At those coordinates the central difference returns the secant subgradient, which is why the kink coordinates are counted and excluded from the relative error instead of being averaged away
objective_gradient_check.method: central finite differences (h=1e-6) against the analytic gradient of the implemented objective

protocol.qp: min (z-zref)' Q_t (z-zref) + lambda||z-z_anchor||^2 + eta*sum(t), s.t. -t<=z-z_source<=t, t>=0, l<=z<=u, A z<=b; Q_t = P' diag(1/sd)^2 Sigma_corr^-1 diag(1/sd)^2 P (rank 10)
protocol.solver: exact ADMM for the declared convex QP: primal-dual, exact box+half-space prox by bisection, Woodbury solve for the rank-10 quadratic; t eliminated at t=|z-z_source| because eta>0
protocol.solverRejected: scipy.optimize.minimize SLSQP was benchmarked on the 462-variable form (z and t): 26-31 s per solve at status=8 with constraint violations up to 7e-4, so it is not used
